name: slippage_aj
shape: An as-of join (each trade with the quote in force when it printed), then a grouped measure over it: the finance shape SQL backends emulate and Deephaven runs natively, ticking
pure: #>{md::MarketData.trades}#->asOfJoin(#>{md::MarketData.quotes}#->rename(~Sym, ~QSym)->rename(~Timestamp, ~QTimestamp), {t, q | $t.Timestamp >= $q.QTimestamp}, {t, q | $t.Sym == $q.QSym})->extend(~Slip: x | if($x.Side == 'BUY', | $x.Price - $x.Ask, | $x.Bid - $x.Price))->groupBy(~[Sym], ~[AvgSlip: x | $x.Slip : y | $y->average(), Trades: x | 1 : y | $y->count(), LastTs: x | $x.Timestamp : y | $y->max()])->sort(~AvgSlip->descending())->limit(1001)

columnSpecs: Slip = Side == `BUY` ? Price - Ask : Bid - Price
